result.rationale: The diff adds pagination where next/previous set group.offset and call group.findMembers(), which fires an AJAX request and unconditionally setProperties(user_count/limit/offset/members) in its then callback. There is no request token, abort, or stale-response guard, so rapid clicks can resolve out of order and clobber state (e.g. currentPage/members desync). This is verifiable from the diff: the mechanism (concurrent in-flight requests writing offsets/members) is present, and no mitigating code exists in the diff.
